thread:
Sasha (PM): ACME (anchor) just said they'll sign if we can deliver tenant-scoped routing + SSO and basic audit logs for a pilot by mid-July. They want a canary with ~10 tenants.

James (Sales): Yep, conditional verbal commit. They asked for a go/no-go date: 2026-07-15. They want production-ish SLAs and exportable logs for the pilot.

Ravi (Eng): Reality check: routing + auth touches multiple stacks. Ballpark: routing changes 3w, OIDC SSO 2w, infra rollout 2w, QA + canary 1-2w. Optimistic ~8w end-to-end.

Marta (Design): We can ship a trimmed admin surface (CSV export + one read-only page) in 1 sprint for pilot. Full multi-tenant admin is a v1 item.

Alex (TPM): Sprint boundary next Tue. Trade options:
- Option A: Pull tenant routing+SSO into current MVP (delay other MVP items)
- Option B: Keep MVP timeline, build a separate narrow pilot and ask ACME to accept pilot constraints
- Option C: Ask ACME to move pilot date out ~3 weeks

Priya (QA): QA can cover a limited pilot (single IdP) in 1 week after infra. Full regression across IdPs needs 2 sprints.

James (Sales): ACME's security folks will want audit assurances. We can offer self-attestation for pilot; full compliance evidence for GA.

Sasha (PM): Quick cutlist I'm proposing for the pilot (deliver by 2026-07-15 if we go this route):
```
Must-have for pilot:
- Tenant-scoped routing (namespace isolation + config)
- SSO (OIDC minimal; SAML adapter later)
- Request-level audit logs (CSV export)
- Canary infra for 10 tenants
Defer to v1:
- Tenant role mgmt UI
- Cross-tenant analytics/billing
- Multi-IdP orchestration
```

Ravi (Eng): Implementation notes: reuse route table with tenant_id prefix + feature-flag, OIDC first, piggyback logs on tracer with CSV export, retention policy TBD.

Marta (Design): I'll drop a one-pager + mock for CSV export and pilot admin.

Alex (TPM): Timeline calc if we don't reprioritize: dev+infra 7w, QA+canary 2w, buffer 1w = ~10w -> misses ACME's date. We need to choose.

Sasha (PM): Voting: react :thumbsup: = Option A, :thumbsdown: = Option C, :white_check_mark: = Option B (narrow pilot + legal caveats).

(30s pause for reactions)

Sasha (PM): Reaction tally from core: 0 :thumbsup:, 1 :thumbsdown: (Marta), 4 :white_check_mark: (Ravi, Priya, James, Alex). Option B wins.

Sasha (PM): Action items:
- James: negotiate pilot SOW + soft window with ACME (deliverables = cutlist). Due EOD tomorrow.
- Ravi: draft RFC for tenant routing + feature flag PR. Due in 3 business days.
- Priya: QA plan scoped to 1 IdP + tenant isolation tests. Due in 5 business days.
- Marta: pilot admin mock + CSV copy. Due in 4 business days.
- Alex: update milestone tracker, record new 'feature-flag pilot' path and revise GA ETA.

James (Sales): I'll push legal on pilot SOW and aim to secure a 1-week slack window (2026-07-22) if needed.

Ravi (Eng): Starting the RFC now, will link here when ready: <rfc-link-placeholder>.

deploy-bot: Reminder: branch protection will require 2 approvers before merges.

Sasha (PM): We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 to confirm PRs and any scope nudges. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
